axes.model_access: Driven by third-party speech-recognition and generative summarisation; the product page does not disclose the model list item by item, and features vary by tier.
axes.runtime: A cloud meeting recorder joins mainstream video meetings; recording, transcription and summaries are processed server-side. Available surfaces depend on the tier, and offline or private deployment needs separate confirmation.
axes.local_files: Can upload audio or video or connect a calendar meeting; local files must be uploaded before processing. Local files usually need upload or authorised access, so confirm storage, retention and deletion.
axes.background: Records during the meeting and produces notes afterwards; there is no general agent that survives shutdown. Tasks are triggered per request and no resident agent remains.
axes.tools: Integrations with Zoom, Meet, Teams, calendar, Slack, Notion and HubSpot; transcripts and clips can be exported.
axes.context: Context is mainly one meeting, past meetings and team spaces; cross-workspace retrieval is permission-controlled. Cross-document and cross-session memory is limited, so complex work needs manual context and source citations.
axes.permissions: Recording requires participant consent; retention, region and team permissions follow the tier and enterprise contract. Permission follows account and organisation settings; redact sensitive material and confirm audit logs and export scope.
axes.fit: Fits: multilingual meeting notes, clip review and customer-call summaries. Does not fit: meetings that require fully local deployment or very high confidentiality.
